title: Supplementary code for: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: Scripts, certificates, run logs and Lean 4 verifications supporting the paper. The package contains the exact chamber certificates of the single-deviation bound, the covering bound at every contact count, the root-system meets and the 600-cell enumeration, the slack continuation, and the three-point semidefinite certificate for the twenty-three-contact case together with its verification in exact rational arithmetic, interval arithmetic and Lean 4. It carries the two steps of the certificate of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer for the twenty-four-contact case that their own verification code leaves out, the construction of the zonal matrices and the four polynomial identities, recomputed from their published data in exact rational arithmetic on an ordinary machine. It also contains the distance criterion for neighbours that do not touch the centre (shell_reduction.py, in ball arithmetic) and a numerical search of the case it leaves open (shell_neighbour_search.py); the verification of the local bound whenever at most twenty-three centres lie within sqrt 6, whatever their distances (labelled_certificate_check.py, in ball and interval arithmetic); the exact content of the section on further reductions (closure_lemmas.py, and in Lean 4 lean/D4Closure.lean); the explicit constant epsilon_0 = 4e-26 of the near-contact theorem (explicit_eps0.py, in ball and exact arithmetic); the three-point certificate on an enlarged domain showing that no 25 points of S^3 have pairwise inner products at most 1/2 + 0.008, so that the kissing number in dimension four is stable (certify_cardinality.py, in exact and interval arithmetic); and an independent re-verification of every computation of the paper. The directory level2 writes the zonal matrices in the file format of the code of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer, so that their second-level programme runs on an ordinary machine, and checks them against that code: all 88 entries of thirteen signatures computed by their own construction agree with ours coefficient by coefficient; count_survey.py minimises the truncated volume for every count of centres within sqrt 6. Version v1.9.0 adds the second order of the cell volume at the root system with an exact copositivity certificate, an exact closed curve of contact cells of volume 8, a second twenty-four-point code with rational coordinates far from the root system, the reduction of the conjecture to two explicit statements, and a proof of the second of them for thirty-one or more centres by a two-point kernel certificate checked in exact and ball arithmetic, its reduction at thirty centres to a single configuration by certificates split into cases, and a proof of the first along the push-outs of the root system; fifteen parts of the paper are checked in Lean 4. Version v1.10.0 shows that the second level with a margin on pairs cannot localise twenty-four points at slack 0.008 at any degree, proves that with 25 to 33 centres and T <= 8 twenty-four lie within 2.444, bounds how many of the twenty-four centres of (G) can lie far out, and gives the two-point bound for every count from 25 to 49. Version v1.11.0 bounds, for 25 to 30 centres, how many lie within 2.05, 2.1, 2.15 and 2.2 and within which radius twenty-four of them lie, and splits the case left open at thirty into two shells. Version v1.11.1 adds two such counts and shows in floating point that the labelled three-point programme cannot exclude a further centre beside twenty-four close ones at degrees 10 and 12 (hole_labelled_sdp.py). The re-verification and these programs were developed, and their computations run, with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic.
